description: KubeDoor AI 助手（网页、企业微信）每轮的模型用量、缓存命中率、上下文占用和压缩次数，数据来自 kubedoor_ai_runs.usage

panels.title: AI 助手用量总览（只统计有用量记录的轮次；网页、企微、MCP 共用）

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.created_at, r.username, s.channel, COALESCE(r.usage->>'model', '未记录') AS model,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'model_calls')::bigint, 0) AS model_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'cache_read_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cache_read_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS output_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'reasoning_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS reasoning_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'last_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS last_input_tokens,
         NULLIF((r.usage->>'max_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS max_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_calls')::bigint, 0) AS summary_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_output_tokens
  FROM kubedoor_ai_runs r JOIN kubedoor_ai_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  WHERE r.usage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at) AND s.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
)
SELECT count(*) AS "对话轮数" FROM runs

panels.description: 企微在 25% 以上会提示「新对话」；达到压缩阈值（默认 50%）会自动摘要。用来判断压缩阈值的默认值是否合适

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.created_at, r.username, s.channel, COALESCE(r.usage->>'model', '未记录') AS model,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'model_calls')::bigint, 0) AS model_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'cache_read_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cache_read_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS output_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'reasoning_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS reasoning_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'last_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS last_input_tokens,
         NULLIF((r.usage->>'max_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS max_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_calls')::bigint, 0) AS summary_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_output_tokens
  FROM kubedoor_ai_runs r JOIN kubedoor_ai_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  WHERE r.usage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at) AND s.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
)
, shares AS (
  SELECT last_input_tokens::float / max_input_tokens AS share FROM runs WHERE max_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND last_input_tokens > 0
)
SELECT bucket AS "占用", count(*) AS "轮数" FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN share < 0.05 THEN '1. <5%' WHEN share < 0.1 THEN '2. 5%–10%' WHEN share < 0.25 THEN '3. 10%–25%'
              WHEN share < 0.5 THEN '4. 25%–50%' ELSE '5. ≥50%' END AS bucket FROM shares
) t GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 每日压缩次数与轮数

panels.description: channel：web 是网页 AI 助手，wecom 是企业微信机器人

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.created_at, r.username, s.channel, COALESCE(r.usage->>'model', '未记录') AS model,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'model_calls')::bigint, 0) AS model_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'cache_read_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cache_read_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS output_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'reasoning_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS reasoning_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'last_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS last_input_tokens,
         NULLIF((r.usage->>'max_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS max_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_calls')::bigint, 0) AS summary_calls,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_input_tokens,
         COALESCE((r.usage->>'summary_output_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS summary_output_tokens
  FROM kubedoor_ai_runs r JOIN kubedoor_ai_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  WHERE r.usage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at) AND s.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
)
SELECT channel AS "渠道", model AS "模型", count(*) AS "轮数", sum(model_calls) AS "调用",
       sum(input_tokens) AS "输入", sum(cache_read_tokens)::float / NULLIF(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS "命中率", sum(output_tokens) AS "输出", sum(reasoning_tokens) AS "推理",
       sum(summary_calls) AS "压缩", (sum(cache_read_tokens) * 0.02 + sum(input_tokens - cache_read_tokens) * 1 + sum(output_tokens) * 4 + sum(summary_input_tokens) * 1 + sum(summary_output_tokens) * 4) / 1000000.0 AS "估算费用"
FROM runs GROUP BY channel, model ORDER BY sum(input_tokens) DESC
